image_description: A rugged, steep rock formation rising against a cloudy sky. The central feature is a prominent, weathered cliff face with visible stratification and rough texture. Patches of green vegetation cling to the ledges and top of the rock. To the right, a sloping terrain with reddish-brown earth and sparse grass connects to the main formation. The lighting suggests daylight with soft shadows, highlighting the craggy surface details.
